access.reason: Registered supporting document; review for package context and routing information, without treating it as a replacement animal or in-vitro dataset. Its body has not been inspected.

Registered proposal, restricted to supplied extracted text. Use for requirements and planned source roles; planned analyses and human validation descriptions are not observations or access authorization.
Candidate core cross-species plasma input. Preserve digitized group-level status, extraction uncertainty, overlapping markers and missing points; do not create individual records or variability.

Candidate reported cross-species PK parameters and animal counts. Preserve source model definitions and the abstract/table discrepancy; reported estimates are not independently validated measurements.
Mixed meropenem and comparator half-life summaries. Review meropenem evidence and retain comparator identity without substituting comparator measurements.
Candidate unchanged-meropenem urinary recovery evidence. Preserve collection windows, untested entries, undefined variability and conflicting dog recovery statements.
Candidate dose-specific reported PK evidence. Keep this experiment separate from Table 1, including its independent 20 mg/kg rows; dose effects are not evaluated here.
Candidate tissue-distribution inputs. Preserve homogenate basis, preparation details, destructive sampling groups and detection limits; these are not plasma, ELF or individual longitudinal curves.
Permitted in-vitro stability evidence for input-context review. Lung homogenate incubation does not establish in-vivo pulmonary concentrations or PK.

Review animal meropenem DHP-I evidence as potential mechanistic context, retaining the inconsistent rhesus entry. Comparator kinetics are not substitutes, DHP-I kinetics are not PK, and removed human rows remain outside access.
Candidate animal serum-binding evidence. Preserve method disagreement and source-specific alternatives without averaging; removed human evidence is not authorized.

Candidate concentration-specific animal plasma-binding evidence. Preserve conflicts, missing methods and cynomolgus versus rhesus identity; do not average alternatives or access the removed human column.
Candidate reported neutropenic-mouse PK and exposure inputs. PK route and sampling details remain unknown; efficacy-route information cannot fill the PK-route gap.

Published fitted PD targets and fit summaries may inform source-availability and endpoint review, but cannot replace per-regimen CFU records or set primary starting values, bounds, priors or rankings. Metadata remain candidate evidence for regimen, MIC and endpoint definitions.

Candidate animal strain-MIC, regimen and exposure-summary inputs. Preserve renal impairment, regimen conflict and comparator separation; humanized animal regimens cannot tune scaling, and untranscribed CFU figures are not available records.

Candidate modeled mouse fT>MIC inputs, retaining their reported status. Exclude comparator substitution, keep human columns inaccessible and prohibit humanized-regimen calibration of scaling; exposure summaries alone do not establish response records.

Mixed reported plasma/ELF PK-PD evidence. Review PK definitions and source availability; route published PD targets to reference-only use, preserve unverified endpoint mapping and cohort inconsistency, and do not convert per-animal apparent parameters into per-kg absolute parameters without justification.

Candidate text-reported mouse PK and binding evidence. Preserve radiation-neutropenic state, SC route, measurement context and conflicting source estimates; no concentration series or individual variability is established.
Candidate systemic plasma concentration-time inputs. Keep day 1 and day 92 dosing contexts distinct, retain terminal subgroup sampling and flag means containing substituted detection-limit values.

Candidate text-reported systemic disposition evidence. Keep unchanged meropenem and total radioactivity separate; the undigitized figure does not supply concentration-time observations in this inventory.
Candidate radiolabel recovery and collection-context evidence. Total radioactivity cannot supply unchanged-meropenem urinary fraction or renal clearance without analyte-specific evidence.
Candidate urinary component identity and denominator evidence. Preserve percentages of urinary radioactivity separately from percentages of administered dose, including H-4295 identity.

Candidate septic-rat reported PK and binding inputs. Preserve SC dosing, whole-blood measurement, PPB/BPR conversion requirements and per-animal volume; inaccessible supplementary concentrations remain unavailable.

Candidate individual reported attainment, regimen and sampling-context evidence. Reported model-derived attainment does not supply underlying concentrations, individual PK variability or matched CFU response records.
Review survival endpoint and regimen context for routing and restrictions. Survival cannot become CFU response or a bacterial-kill target; retain the reported inconclusive microbiological response.

Candidate reported rabbit plasma/CSF parameter and component-support evidence; eligibility remains unresolved. Preserve per-animal units, sampling-count discrepancies and figure-only concentrations, and route the hollow-fiber target separately from rabbit evidence.

Candidate rabbit binding evidence with unverified species-value pairing and preprint status. Review the animal extraction without accessing held-out human values; do not accept the inferred pairing silently.

Candidate reported dog PK parameters and dosing context. Keep unchanged meropenem, H-4295 and radiolabel distinct; preserve sex, summary level and ambiguous dose-volume wording without reconstructing unavailable curves.
Candidate analyte-specific dog urinary amounts and collection intervals. Preserve radioactivity equivalents, metabolite correction, detection flags and differing contributing counts.

Candidate tissue radioactivity and sampling-context evidence. One dog at each terminal time is not an individual longitudinal curve; total tissue radioactivity is not unchanged-meropenem plasma or tissue PK.
Candidate repeat-dose dog PK summaries and schedule evidence. Preserve day-specific context and conflicting printed AUC/C0 units; do not silently correct units or substitute unavailable curves.

Candidate repeat-dose urinary recovery evidence. Preserve compound identity, collection intervals and percentage of the corresponding day's dose; keep repeat dosing separate from single-dose evidence.

Candidate abstract-reported IV/SC dog evidence. Keep routes and tissue fluid versus plasma separate; the recommended 8 mg/kg regimen is not an administered study regimen, and full-text concentrations are unavailable.

Candidate reported cynomolgus PK evidence. Preserve conflicting sex/count statements, dose-volume wording and printed AUC units; unavailable concentration curves and unresolved identities cannot be reconstructed.
Candidate monkey radiolabel recovery and collection-context evidence. Retain total-radioactivity identity and sex/count context; do not substitute it for unchanged-meropenem excretion.

Candidate individual urinary analyte and recovery evidence. Preserve source animal labels and conflicting collection-window descriptions; urinary individual records do not establish individual plasma PK variability.

Candidate maternal/fetal plasma and dose-history evidence in a separate pregnant subgroup. Preserve the 300 versus 360 mg/kg conflict and repeat-dose history; do not pool with non-pregnant systemic PK.

Candidate matched meropenem isolate MICs. Linked EUCAST notes are a potential separate distribution source requiring routing and boundary review; they do not establish table coverage, cell associations or denominator completeness. Comparators cannot replace meropenem MICs.

Explicitly unassigned cells require an authorized table plan before body review or source association. MIC-distribution requirements are potential matches only; nearby linked notes do not establish identity or permission.

findings.reason: UNASSIGNED cells remain NEEDS_REVIEW. Their source, table boundaries and access scope cannot be inferred from adjacent MIC notes.

findings.reason: Comparative isolate-MIC metadata include linked notes for a distinct EUCAST distribution. This is a potential routing relationship, not evidence that distribution counts belong to this table.
findings.needed_material: File-review disclosure and recorded source-to-table routing for the comparative MIC block and any separately authorized distribution block.
